gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-pilcrow-rou: Stretched, glowing, almost humming. Pilcrow Rounded follows in a plain sans with a tall lowercase and curves that stay open, while Neuropolitical earns its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-quicksand: Neuropolitical looks pulled apart, letter by letter, like neon tubing. Quicksand sits beneath it as a plain sans with glassy, rounded bowls, softening the heading's sharp geometry into something friendlier to read.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-alpino: Nordic is powerful and ancient, its letters spaced like brush dabs set far apart. Alpino, though, is cozy and casual, a tall plain sans whose curve endings stay open where the heading's stay tightly closed.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-hind: Ancient, brushy, spaced wide apart. Hind takes over below with lowercase that nearly matches its capitals and open curves, a steady sans against Nordic's closed, cramped letter shapes.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Powerful, with brush-dab spacing and cramped, closed letters, Nordic carries the top. Pilcrow Rounded follows with a tall lowercase and curves that refuse to close, so a long paragraph feels warm and easy to move through.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-quicksand: Powerful, ancient Nordic closes its letters up tight, spaced like far-apart brush dabs. Quicksand follows with a plain sans of glassy, rounded bowls, so a long stretch of text reads open and soft.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-spline-sans: Round, commanding, classic. Spline Sans keeps its curve ends well away from the stems in a plain sans, and that open, approachable body is the quality that best sets off Oldtimer's parenthesis-like forms.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-nunito: Nunito reads soft and approachable, with big round bowls and terminals that finish clear of the stem. Origami's tube-like strokes suit large sizes.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Unique, with a sign-painter's brush stroke and heavy lead-type lowercase, Origami leads the way. Pilcrow Rounded, with its tight letter spacing, may want a little more size.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-quicksand: Quicksand reads soft, its tall bowls round like glass bulbs. Outrun Future goes authoritative with wide-set letters and a traceable outline, while Quicksand keeps every line approachable.
